title: ourisia ruellioides
intro: Ourisia ruellioides, commonly known as the Rock Rose, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. This plant is known for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Ourisia ruellioides include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for pain relief and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
